---
name: Defensive review rule
about: Suggest a code-review check or a clearer explanation of a finding
title: '[RULE] '
labels: 'enhancement, rule'
assignees: ''
---

## Code-review goal

Which behavior should the review check, and which project or platform assumptions matter?

## Expected result

Describe the finding or guidance a maintainer should receive. Include a safe example or a public reference if it helps explain the distinction between correct and incorrect behavior.

## Scope and limitations

When should the review skip the check? Mention expected false positives. Report sensitive details about Doublecheck itself through the [private reporting form](https://github.com/poferraz/doublecheck/security/advisories/new).
